_doc: The player's six skills (scripts/skills.gd). id: what the story names in a `# skill:<id>` tag and in roll("<id>", ...); name and description: shown on the character sheet (C) and in the dialogue log; color: the skill's voice in the log; value: where a new game starts, 1 to 5. difficulties: the named levels of a check, easiest first; a check is two six-sided dice plus the skill against the number, a passive check is the skill plus 6 against it.

skills.name: Sentry's Eye
skills.description: Seeing what moves, what does not, and what should not be there.

skills.name: Folk Sense
skills.description: The mood of a room, and the thing a man is not saying.

skills.name: Bearing
skills.description: Being obeyed by people who have no reason to.

skills.name: Tally
skills.description: Counting, accounts and arguments, in that order of reliability.

skills.name: Backbone
skills.description: Keeping your face still while the rest of you is not.

skills.name: The Rock
skills.description: The old castle, thinking. Slowly, and mostly about weather.
